kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أحتفل (form VIII)
# أَحْتَفِلُ (ʔaḥtafilu) /ʔaħ.ta.fi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
# أُحْتَفَلُ (ʔuḥtafalu) /ʔuħ.ta.fa.lu/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
# أَحْتَفِلَ (ʔaḥtafila) /ʔaħ.ta.fi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
# أُحْتَفَلَ (ʔuḥtafala) /ʔuħ.ta.fa
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
